articles.title: Doximity CEO Jeff Tangney on Putting Doctors First as AI Rewrites Healthcare
articles.summary: Doximity has grown from a Stanford dorm-room idea into a platform trusted by 85% of U.S. physicians, guided by a simple “physicians first” mantra. CEO Jeff Tangney goes Inside the ICE House to discuss how AI scribes and clinical decision tools are giving doctors back time and face-to-face connection with patients. He explains why accuracy, not replacement, is physicians’ top AI concern and how verification layers build trust. Having surfed the dot-com, mobile, and telehealth waves, he reflects on why AI may be the biggest one yet for healthcare.

DoseCheck verifies drug dosing recommendations against FDA labeling and professional guidelines and is available free to all Doximity Ask users.
